steps.title: Data Cleaning
steps.code:
import pandas as pd

def function(inputs, parameters, context):
    df = inputs['data'].copy()
    df['InvoiceDate'] = pd.to_datetime(df['InvoiceDate'], errors='coerce')
    df['Description'] = df['Description'].fillna('Unknown')
    df['CustomerID'] = df['CustomerID'].fillna('Unknown')
    df['is_valid_sale'] = ~df['InvoiceNo'].str.startswith('C', na=False) & (df['Quantity'] > 0) & (df['UnitPrice'] > 0)
    return {'cleaned': df}
steps.rationale: This step normalizes dates, fills missing values, and adds a validity flag for sales.

steps.title: Data Analysis
steps.code:
import pandas as pd

def function(inputs, parameters, context):
    df = inputs['cleaned']
    valid_sales = df[df['is_valid_sale']]
    valid_sales = valid_sales.assign(sales_value=valid_sales['Quantity'] * valid_sales['UnitPrice'])
    sales_value = valid_sales['sales_value'].sum()
    invoice_lines = valid_sales.shape[0]
    invoices = valid_sales['InvoiceNo'].nunique()
    excluded_lines = df[~df['is_valid_sale']].shape[0]
    discount_pct = parameters['discount_pct']
    scenario_sales_value = sales_value * (1 - discount_pct / 100)
    country_totals = valid_sales.groupby('Country', as_index=False)['sales_value'].sum().nlargest(10, 'sales_value')
    daily_sales = valid_sales.assign(date=valid_sales['InvoiceDate'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')).groupby('date', as_index=False)['sales_value'].sum()
    item_totals = valid_sales.groupby('Description', as_index=False)['sales_value'].sum().nlargest(10, 'sales_value')
    top_items = {'option': {'xAxis': {'type': 'value', 'name': 'GBP'}, 'yAxis': {'type': 'category', 'data': item_totals['Description'].tolist()}, 'series': [{'type': 'bar', 'data': item_totals['sales_value'].tolist()}]}}
    invoice_detail = valid_sales.copy()
    return {'sales_value': sales_value, 'invoice_lines': invoice_lines, 'invoices': invoices, 'excluded_lines': excluded_lines, 'scenario_sales_value': scenario_sales_value, 'country_totals': country_totals, 'daily_sales': daily_sales, 'top_items': top_items, 'invoice_detail': invoice_detail}

steps.title: Monthly Country Mix
steps.code:
import pandas as pd

def function(inputs, parameters, context):
    valid_sales = inputs['cleaned'].loc[inputs['cleaned']['is_valid_sale']].copy()
    valid_sales['sales_value'] = valid_sales['Quantity'] * valid_sales['UnitPrice']
    valid_sales['month'] = valid_sales['InvoiceDate'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m')
    pivot = valid_sales.pivot_table(index='month', columns='Country', values='sales_value', aggfunc='sum', fill_value=0).reindex(['2011-01', '2011-02', '2011-03'], fill_value=0)
    top = pivot.sum().nlargest(5).index.tolist()
    series = [{'name': str(c), 'type': 'bar', 'stack': 'sales', 'data': pivot[c].tolist()} for c in top]  
    remaining = [c for c in pivot.columns if c not in top]  
    series.append({'name': 'Other', 'type': 'bar', 'stack': 'sales', 'data': pivot[remaining].sum(axis=1).tolist()})
    monthly_country_mix = {'option': {'legend': {}, 'xAxis': {'type': 'category', 'data': pivot.index.tolist()}, 'yAxis': {'type': 'value', 'name': 'GBP'}, 'series': series}}
    return {'monthly_country_mix': monthly_country_mix}
steps.rationale: This step aggregates sales value by month and country, creating a stacked bar chart for visualization.
